limits: Font-dependent format signs are counted as drawing requirements and also need contextual behaviour validation; other controls need separate behaviour evidence.
Single-character selection is not proof that a larger cluster or mixed-script run keeps the same font.
Positive geometry does not rule out a wrong drawing or a visible placeholder.
COLR v0 layers are inspected as outlines; final colour/alpha/pixel appearance still needs browser evidence.
Context-only exceptions require independent native shaping tests; they are not invented visible drawings.
Known semantic blanks use dedicated app layout; other dynamic compositors still require their own runtime evidence.
